headline: Nandrolone
body: In both juvenile and adult rats. Measured on cephalometric X-rays.
punch: And the adult result is the one people miss.

headline: The study
body: Wistar-Kyoto rats, juvenile and adult, split into treated and control groups. Lateral head films taken before and after, digitised and enlarged to 300% for measurement precision.
punch: Two age groups, two dimensions, real cephalometry.

headline: In juveniles
body: Mandibular length went up 27.2% in treated animals against 24.5% in controls. Mandibular height went up 41.2% against 32.0%.

headline: In adults
body: Adult controls gained 0.3% mandibular length. Adult treated animals gained 4.7%, which is 3.6 mm against 0.2 mm.
punch: Controls had basically stopped. Treated adults hadn't.

headline: Which is the actual finding
body: Anabolic steroids grew the mandible in animals that had already finished most of their growth. This is not only a puberty window effect.
punch: Adult craniofacial bone is not inert to this.

headline: The mechanism runs
body: Juvenile treated and control rats had similar IGF-1 levels. Adult treated rats had higher IGF-1 than adult controls, and their serum level rose 383% against 255%.
punch: In adults the hormone difference tracked the bone difference.

headline: Both dimensions moved
body: Horizontal and vertical cephalometric distances both increased more in treated animals, in both age groups. The jaw got longer and taller.

headline: The limits
subhead: ARE THE SPECIES AND THE DOSE
body: Female Wistar-Kyoto rats on supraphysiologic nandrolone. Rodent craniofacial growth is not human craniofacial growth, and nothing here tells you the size of the effect in a person.
punch: Direction is clear. Magnitude in humans is not.

headline: It's never over
body: Real mechanisms, real citations, no protocols.
